snippet.title: The official trailer for Version 1.8 "Danqing Season" is now live!
snippet.description:
♾️The official trailer for Version 1.8 "Danqing Season" is now live!
Loong lies coiled on ancient scrolls,
Brush and sky in silent roles.
Ink and color weave the years,
And paint the world with hopes and tears.

Version 1.8 of Infinity Nikki "Danqing Season" officially launches on July 29 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for new events, a new area, a new ability outfit, new collectibles... and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!
——
The Coziest Open-World Game!
Infinity Nikki Version 1.8 "Danqing Season" launches globally on July 29 (UTC-7)!

#InfinityNikki
